title: What's in a Tree ? Hierarchical $n$-gram models as controlled approximators of language
abstract: arXiv:2611.23093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hierarchical models have been proposed as synthetic settings for studying language. However, their relevance to realistic language corpora remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce tree-grams, autoregressive generative $n$-gram models that build the conditional probability tensor $p(x_n \mid x_{1:n-1})$ through a hierarchical composition of order-2 and order-3 tensors. $n$ controls the maximal context window, whereas a rank hyperparameter $d$ controls model capacity, yielding an interpretable and systematically scalable family of approximators of language. We show how tree-grams outperform existing $n$-gram baselines, while remaining competitive with deep transformer-based language models. We demonstrate the utility of such controlled approximations by using tree-grams as generative models. translated_title: 树中有什么？层次化 n-gram 模型作为语言的可控近似器
translated_abstract: 层次化模型已被提出作为研究语言的合成环境，但它们与现实语言语料库的相关性仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了 tree-grams，这是一类自回归生成式 n-gram 模型，通过对二阶和三阶张量的层次化组合来构建条件概率张量 p(x_n | x_{1:n-1})。其中，n 控制最大上下文窗口，而秩超参数 d 控制模型容量，由此产生了一个可解释且可系统性扩展的语言近似器家族。我们展示了 tree-grams 如何超越现有的 n-gram 基线，同时与基于深度 Transformer 的语言模型保持竞争力。我们还通过将 tree-grams 用作生成模型，展示了这种受控近似的实用性。特别是，我们表明当在更简单的数据上调优更窄的模型时，μP 下的超参数迁移可以变得更加稳健。
tldr: 本文提出 tree-grams——一种通过二阶和三阶张量层次化组合构建的自回归 n-gram 模型，其上下文窗口与模型容量分别由超参数 n 和 d 可控地调节，在超越传统 n-gram 基线的同时可与 Transformer 语言模型媲美，并可作为研究语言的可控近似器用于超参数迁移等实验。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces tree-grams, autoregressive hierarchical n-gram models built via composition of order-2 and order-3 tensors, where context window (n) and capacity (d) are controllable hyperparameters; they outperform n-gram baselines and remain competitive with transformers, serving as controlled approximators of language for studies such as robust hyperparameter transfer under μP.
